balancing.cumulative_formula: reference_bonus = pre_skill_reference * (tier_percentage_per_rank/100) * min(purchased_rank, level_cap); no compounding, no self-referential attribute calculation
balancing.mana_resource_reference: personal/native unmodified mana capacity for that magic system. Not shared across mods; do not apply to machines.
balancing.mixed_stat_reference: For native fixed-unit mana, damage, health, cooldown, proc chance, status duration or utility, choose source-verified reference and conversion; class tier is power budget not mandatory direct percentage of live effect.
balancing.core_existing_4: Five rank-one-SP first-wave files already hold 20/40/60/80/100% of their previously defined rank-99 terminal fixed values, not a verified +20% of each underlying mod's initial mana. Reconcile base value only after cross-mod QA.
capped_effects: defenses and damage resistance not beyond a tested mitigation hard ceiling
chance 0..100%, often a much smaller tuned ceiling
cost reduction with nonzero payment floor
regeneration explicit HP/tick or HP/sec benchmarks where vanilla baseline zero
loot/yield/bonemeal/crafting no dupes, repeat credit or world automation loops
spell/buff effects only upon legitimate source-attributed action
balancing.endgame_effective_bonus: Nominal +500% or higher is appropriate for large Dragon mana, but no uncontrolled multiplication of competing tiers; same mechanic bonuses share a pre-skill basis and are additive unless a documented exception.
balancing.external_gating: Native form/faction plus milestone at purchase AND effect time; refund prerequisites; direct grants reconciled; one global MXP/Tyz XP+SP wallet.
balancing.native_owners: JAWR vampire/wolf; standalone Monk/Hunter; Dragon Survival dragons; verified Lich/Goety/Forbidden Magic; TeamLapen Vampirism/Werewolves are retirement targets and are not future skill providers.
balancing.hunter_special_rules: Undead, demon and fae identified by actual sourced tags; one entity counts once, gated boss multipliers; target glowing at late rank with bounded scan/cooldown and no players. Dragon quarry specialization independent of dimension or boss tags.
balancing.lich_blood_nature_tradeoff: Blood nodes strengthen source-verified personal Neo Vitae/EvilCraft/other blood spell outputs; after all positive nature modifiers, multiply only the lich's own personal Botania/Roots nature spell output by (1 - min(0.75, 0.02*entry_blood_ranks + 0.03*advanced_blood_ranks + 0.05*mastery_blood_ranks)). No machine or passive production debuffs.
balancing.monk_policy: Do not add spirit projectile; Ars/Iron's spells supply range. Treasure Hand single native Fortune/Silk toggle, Fortune Tyz modifier licensed; reserved hotbar slot 1 and armor-lock toggle are non-purchasable native effects. All 40 source-bounded affix rarities have 2-5 special caps, not generalized to 5/10/25/50.

overall_endgame_power_hierarchy.primary_benchmark: A fully progressed Monk, using no armor, Curios, worn equipment or weapons, must be approximately combat-equivalent OVERALL to another appropriately progressed specialist with progression-appropriate fully enchanted and Apotheosis-affixed gear. Monk remains the strongest intrinsic/no-gear specialist. No blanket rule that Monk beats fully geared characters.
overall_endgame_power_hierarchy.other_tree_limit: Compared as complete BUILDS, equipped specialists can slightly exceed Monk in one or two intended niches and be moderately weaker elsewhere, yielding broadly comparable endgame ability, not dramatically lower aggregate power. Other trees without gear are not the primary comparator.
overall_endgame_power_hierarchy.narrow_niches_may_exceed_monk: A fully specced AND appropriately geared dragon should have greater practical maximum mana and spell power than equipment-free maxed Monk, after counting all worn spell-stat items, Apotheosis affixes, gems and enchantments; Hunter's equipped quarry combat, Werewolf's equipped HP regeneration, and Sea Dragon's gear-inclusive Luck may likewise be superior.
overall_endgame_power_hierarchy.no_cross_tree_cheat: Use a common/declared Core Skills baseline and comparable total native-form and Tyz skill progression. Exclude extra independent specialist trees from default one-to-one tests. Hybrid and mixed-form builds require separate budgets.
overall_endgame_power_hierarchy.equipment_normalization: Full comparable progression-tier loadouts are part of the non-Monk baseline, never omitted. Count armor, weapons, tools, enchanted gear, Apotheosis affixes/reforges/sockets and gems, Curios and other equipped/accessory bonuses, offhand/cast foci and legitimate consumables under a declared test profile. Do not compare against naked alternatives or selectively suppress gear effects.
overall_endgame_power_hierarchy.monk_benchmark_loadout: No worn armor, Curios or worn gear; no wielded weapons/tools/shields for the naked/unarmed Chaos Guardian acceptance test. Nonworn food/consumables and cast implements still require explicit ruling; do not invent an innate projectile.
comparison_dimensions: measured damage and boss kill time
max personal mana with all equipment
effective actual spell power with all equipment
armor and tool effectiveness at their actual tier
overall_endgame_power_hierarchy.target_relation: Monk has greatest INTRINSIC full-kit, gear-independent combat capacity, but total Monk-vs-geared-specialist capability should be roughly balanced. Specialists may win slightly in their roles; Monk is not automatically 50% or 100% stronger when worn gear and enchantments are counted.
overall_endgame_power_hierarchy.qualification: No numerical balance achieved yet. Percentage values are skill tiers only, not full-build output guarantees; gear may materially shift every theoretical rank. Source-verified modifiers and head-to-head playtests required.

chaos_guardian_monk_acceptance.desired_result: A solo maxed Monk can finish the real Chaos Guardian encounter with no armor, no Curios, no other worn equipment and no weapons.
required_scope: legally interact with its damage/defense and crystal/shield phases
handle the movement and attack reach required during the actual encounter
finish without external players, pre-damaged boss, commands or boss rule bypass
retain meaningful threat, timing, healing/cooldown and skill expression; not permanent invulnerability
budget_constraints: No other specialist class skills required
Do not add a native Monk projectile; ranged solutions must comply with actual allowed source-backed casting or movement/strike mechanics
The allowed consumables, spellcasting implements and non-worn inventory items are a later explicit playtest contract and are NOT silently assumed to be prohibited
chaos_guardian_monk_acceptance.comparison_note: This is a constraint on unarmed/unworn MONK viability, not proof that Monk should exceed appropriately geared characters in aggregate. Other forms get armor/Curios, enchanted weapons/tools and Apotheosis affixes in the balance comparison.

sea_dragon_luck.qualifier: Luck % is a relative design budget against a nonzero Luck benchmark; native Luck starts at zero in many cases, so do not automatically apply relative percentage to raw current Luck. Actual per-rank Luck attribute value or mod-specific odds formula is undecided.
sea_dragon_luck.goal: Intentionally exceptional Luck far above other classes, including in legitimate source-verified luck-aware systems. No global guaranteed rare-drop duplication or boss-gating bypass.
sea_dragon_luck.verification: Audit actual NeoForge 1.21.1 Luck attribute and installed mod loot/fishing/roll behavior.

gear_normalized_balance_contract.question: Can an equipment-free fully progressed Monk and a similarly progressed specialist in appropriately-tiered fully modified gear handle the same late-game challenge at broadly comparable effectiveness, with modest specialist advantages?

primary_monk_profile.progression: Legitimately maxed standalone Monk native and Monk Tyz talents; identical universal Core Skills budget/reference where appropriate
primary_monk_profile.worn_equipment: NONE (empty armor, Curios/accessory slots and any other worn slots)
primary_monk_profile.hand_equipment: No held weapons or tools for strict naked/unarmed combat benchmark; decide precise spell implement and non-worn consumable policy before test
primary_monk_profile.innate_power: Monk-only natural defenses, physical skills, legal unarmed strikes/harvesting, and properly licensed affix-equivalent effects; never assume normal equipped Apotheosis gear bonuses are also present
primary_monk_profile.challenge: Real Chaos Guardian solo clear with legal authentic fight mechanics

comparison_specialist_profile.progression: Legitimately comparable faction/species advancement and appropriately comparable Tyz SP budget, normalized Core Skills rank portfolio, not stacked other specialists
comparison_specialist_profile.gear: Appropriate-tier armor, weapon(s), tools, offhand/casting implement, Curios and other equipped accessories as legitimately usable by that form
comparison_specialist_profile.enhancements: Allowed enchantments, Apotheosis affixes/reforges and sockets/gems on eligible pieces, item attributes, material progression and applicable legitimate buffs
comparison_specialist_profile.quality_band: Representative achievable tier-appropriate endgame configuration, NOT naked, not unreasonably perfect RNG or unavailable hypothetical item builds
comparison_specialist_profile.accounting: Measure final effective output with every actual modifier, cap, proc and source rule applied; do not treat labels such as 'Extreme' as a replacement for geared output measurement.

success_conditions: Monk can genuinely solo the real Chaos Guardian with no worn gear or weapons (external test restrictions to be finalized), with a challenging fight and no boss bypass
A comparably progressed, appropriately geared specialist is broadly viable in the same encounter; Monk is not assumed stronger than the specialist's complete equipped build
One or two designated specialist metrics may be slightly above Monk at full gear; the target for Dragon mana and spell power is ABOVE Monk after enchantments and Apotheosis are included
Ungeared specialists are allowed to be far weaker than Monk, because gear-dependent scaling is intentional
No double credit: Monk cannot simultaneously receive a conceptual replacement for gear affixes and actual worn affix bonuses while under equipment-free mode
Rank and affix stacking remain source-accurate; use measured gameplay outcomes for defense, magic and damage rather than naïvely adding displayed percent bonuses
tests: Construct matching progress snapshots: advancement milestone, effective MXP/Tyz lifetime budget, class skill investment, magic mod unlocks, and resource time investment

Prepare baseline Monarch/Monk with truly empty armor/Curios/worn slots and unarmed hotbar and specialist with expected fully enchanted/reforged high-tier items, socketed gems and armor/tool/weapon properties
Measure spell power and mana against base, full gear-only, full skills-only, and gear-plus-skills snapshots to detect duplicated or multiplicative stacking
Measure Chaos Guardian genuine survival/kill time/mobility/range and phase handling across at least Monk and Hunter/Dragon/Werewolf profiles without skipping phases
Measure identical non-boss archetypes and special quarry/farm/resource scenarios; a slightly better niche is allowed but a universal-class blowout is not
Audit source attribution for rare Apotheosis modifier procs and enchanted tools instead of comparing tooltip percentages only
pending_decisions: What constitutes a representative appropriately-tiered endgame gear set per class/mod
Which non-worn items and casting implements are allowed for the strict Monk fight
How to normalize per-class MXP/SP earned vs native progression gates
Quantitative acceptable parity band and specialist niche edge

noncombat_parity_2026_11_15.comparison: legitimately maxed gearless Monk versus same-stage fully optimized LEGALLY geared specialist including armor/tools/Curios, enchantments, affixes/gems and normal source
noncombat_parity_2026_11_15.rule: For any genuinely comparable non-combat personal output, adjust Monk late ranks so its complete final output is 80%-90% of the fully optimized specialist's final result, including gear. Use 80% for Sea Luck and 85% default. Scope excludes combat, native vampire blood/lich biology, machines and noncomparable systems.
noncombat_parity_2026_11_15.rank_calibration: Monk rank step = max(0, ratio*specialist_full_geared - already_present_monk_plus_core)/max_rank, after source-specific rounding; do not use %-of-vanilla-zero for Luck.
noncombat_parity_2026_11_15.risk: If +100% tier base Dragon mana/Sea Luck exceeds plausible Monk values with gear, the class source baselines must be recalibrated after exact-mod equipment audit. New Monk skills are not installed.

Monk is absolute top of overall personal combat / survivability / movement / adaptability power hierarchy. No other tree can be comparable in all those domains at once. A specialist can rival Monk only in one or two designated niches.

Boss test should require true no-worn-equipment including armor and Curios and no melee/ranged weapons; the precise policy for consumables, cast implements and non-worn utility should be frozen with the encounter acceptance test. Do not revive rejected innate Spirit Bolt.

Balance all Monk total effects, including innate gear/Apotheosis-like affix substitutes, AGAINST a comparably progressed specialist wearing appropriately-tiered enchantable/Affixed armor, weapons/tools and Curios. Monk is not required to defeat the FULLY GEARED equivalent in overall effective power; it must be approximately competitive.
Maxed Monk noncombat sources target 80%-90% of FULLY GEARED best comparable specialist, not 80%-90% of innate Tyz bonus. Sea Luck explicitly 0.8× equipped Sea Luck.
